fields.v: Gaps in the field: benchmarks for real workflows (multi-language, large code bases, interactive and tool-integrated tasks); metrics beyond functional correctness; standard multi-agent protocols; domain-specific models; safety, privacy and trust; toolchains exposing structured feedback and IR; scalable memory; human-AI collaboration; structured languages to state intent and constraints. Limitations of the survey itself: not discussed
